qualification: Results are independent comparisons against accepted35215, not JavaScript parity.
Native replay excludes DOM capture/application; packed is installed29-test React/DOMsuite.
Shared desktop and unrelatedDBcontaineractivity remained; coordinated compilers paused, allblocksretained.
Peak logical payload excludes allocator/BTree overhead per existing accounting contract.
Cache hits preserve fresh owner/token and projection syntax/ABI checks; exact successful projection wire plus immutable state identity certifies reused result and quotas.
The cache uses only slack under the existing cap and does not evict typed states to fit a projection.
No source changes were needed after timing to obtain coverage.
